description: Defines the H3App class for managing HTTP/3 server operations, including context creation, listening on ports, and setting HTTP method handlers within the uWS namespace.

classes.name: H3App
classes.description: A class encapsulating HTTP/3 server setup, including context management, route handling, and server execution.

methods.name: H3App
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP/3 context with provided socket options.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Overloaded methods to start listening on specified host and port with optional parameters and a callback handler.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP GET requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP POST requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP OPTIONS requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP DELETE requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP PATCH requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP PUT requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP HEAD requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP CONNECT requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Sets a handler for HTTP TRACE requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Sets a handler for any HTTP method matching a pattern.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the event loop to run the server.
